_comment: Copy to local.json on each microscope PC (local.json is not shared). Every key is optional.

micromanager.name: Micro-Manager (DMD scope config)
micromanager.note: In the startup dialog choose ham_cam1.cfg.

_comment_micromanager: Start-MicroManager.bat: one entry or several (a menu). before = cmd commands run first, in order; a failing one stops the start; use start "" <program> for one that keeps running. Every key but dir is optional.
